reserveReview.rationale: The complete August 31, 2026 examination reports EUR 395,424,211 of cash at regulated financial institutions less EUR 2,139,303 of net timing and settlement adjustments, totaling EUR 393,284,908 of reserve assets. Net cash divided by the examined denominator, EUR 393,284,908, times 100 is exactly 100%. This uses only examined EUR amounts, with no weekly SIFI/non-SIFI split or invented residual. The aggregate bank row carries one conservative common-mode issuer domain; the live adapter uses the same bank-deposits key and retains its weekly bank-category amounts only in contextual metadata.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete August 31, 2026 examined EUR bank-cash balances net of settlement adjustments; independently reproduced arithmetic under D01
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All examined reserve assets are euro bank cash net of timing and settlement adjustments. Individual banks and their shares are not disclosed. The aggregate bank category receives no inferred diversification credit; the weekly SIFI/non-SIFI split does not describe this report period.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Circle's MiCA white paper, section D.3, states that funds received in exchange for EURC are protected against other creditors of Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS, including in enforcement or insolvency proceedings. The EURC Terms and August 2026 examination define reserves as unencumbered segregated accounts apart from corporate funds, held for holders. The August 31 examination reports EUR 395,424,211 of bank cash less EUR 2,139,303 of timing and settlement adjustments. It does not identify individual banks, institution count, provider-level shares, or replacement arrangements. Rehypothecation terms remain unknown. The issuer page describes EEA financial institutions but also retains a conflicting US-institution footnote; account-level placement is not disclosed.
